newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet barges trade at steady differentials.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet barges trade at steady differentials.

text.p: Jet fuel barges traded on Thursday at steady levels in a fairly tight but quiet market in northwest Europe, traders said.
August IPE ended 25 cents firmer at $165.25 a tonne.
A 2,000 tonne barge moved at the unchanged level of August IPE +$18 fob Rotterdam for delivery by end July.
A second 2,000 tonne parcel changed hands at the same differential for delivery in the first eight days of August.
Cargoes were talked at around August IPE +$17/$18 cif NWE.
